description: The api target group's health check holds its declaration (path /healthz, 200, every 30 seconds, 2 healthy and 3 unhealthy), and both services run at their desired counts

matrix_rows.gap: Health check and desired counts; the alarms are judged by mla-osm-cfg-aws-alarms-target-detection.
The load balancer's health check is the post-apply check, as declared; a failing deploy is rolled back by the circuit breaker (cmt-vtd-ops-failing-deploy-rolls-back).
